Message from TRX Virtual Assistant:
TRX products purchased from TRX, an official reseller, or an authorized distributor may be covered by a specified warranty. You can review the detailed terms on the TRX Warranty Page. 
Please note that warranty coverage generally does not include damage caused by accident, neglect, modification, abuse, misuse, improper use, environmental conditions, impact, normal wear and tear, surface damage that does not materially affect functionality, natural product deterioration, abnormal use, or continued use after discovering a defect. Gray market goods, used goods, and products sold by unapproved third parties are not covered.

Verify whether your item is under warranty from our site.
Register your TRX product before making a warranty claim through Serial Number Registration.
Submit a request with:
Order # (SOTRX###### or TRX-US-##### or TRX-EU-######)
Serial # (13 digits—that's different from the serial on packaging)
Photos of the product defect or damage outside of normal wear and tear or surface damage, which impacts the functionality of the product
